claim_boundary.supported: compare forecasting accuracy when every external baseline uses one fixed H720-trained model per dataset and serves H96/H192/H336 by prefix cropping
claim_boundary.not_supported: matched mechanism attribution across heterogeneous official repositories, optimizers, lookbacks, selectors, test loaders, seeds, and parameter budgets
claim_boundary.matched_attribution_route: five-dataset end-to-end ablations and decoder-transfer controls remain separate

main_i_dependency.exchange_reason: the frozen Main I has no complete H720 anchor for AMD, SimpleTM, iTransformer, PatchTST, or DLinear on Exchange

prediction_contract.external_training: one official-source fixed-H model with pred_len=720 per dataset and native repetition
prediction_contract.iscf_bsca_training: reuse the frozen dataset-level unified ISCF-BSCA-MAIN-v1 checkpoint; no retraining
prediction_contract.test_loader: each system uses its frozen native H720 official-test loader for the primary continuity table
prediction_contract.canonical_tensor_layout: convert each repository output batch to [origin,time,channel] with a source-audited model-specific permutation before any metric or crop
prediction_contract.prefix_rule: for H in [96,192,336,720], compare canonical prediction[:,0:H,:] with canonical target[:,0:H,:] from the same H720 test batches
prediction_contract.prefix_identity_gate: the H96/H192/H336 outputs must be exact in-memory slices of the same H720 forward tensor for every batch, sample, and channel
prediction_contract.metric_rule: recompute global elementwise mean squared error and mean absolute error with float64 accumulators over streamed H720 prediction/target batches; also retain each repository native H720 metric for continuity audit
prediction_contract.tensor_audit_rule: for 63 newly executed evaluations, retain canonical shape, origin count, channel count, and deterministic SHA256 for every prediction/target prefix; the 7 prior completed ISCF evaluations instead retain hashes of their dense 720-row metric CSV, diagnostic NPZ, invariant JSON, and immutable checkpoint because their full arrays were not retained by the already completed audit
prediction_contract.array_retention_rule: under the remote 220 GiB hard limit, process one checkpoint at a time and remove only its exact pred.npy/true.npy inputs after prefix_metrics.json and hashes are durably written; checkpoints, configs, logs, metrics, hashes, and continuity evidence remain persistent
prediction_contract.chpc_consequence: all four requests are nested views of one H720 trajectory produced once for each checkpoint
prediction_contract.cross_system_origin_caveat: official test loaders differ in drop_last and batch semantics; the primary table is source-native system context, not a strictly matched-origin mechanism experiment
prediction_contract.optional_common_origin_sensitivity: after primary completion, a separately labeled intersection-origin sensitivity analysis may be run only with explicit formal-test authorization; it must not replace the native-continuity H720 audit

h720_continuity_gate.exact_rule: same checkpoint, data preprocessing, native H720 loader, repetition aggregation, and metric implementation must reproduce the frozen Main I H720 value within numeric tolerance
h720_continuity_gate.published_rule: Main I values are published three-run means; the new official single-seed H720 result receives a signed deviation audit and is not required to equal or replace the frozen published value
h720_continuity_gate.simpletm_aggregation: evaluate all three frozen native H720 repetition checkpoints and average them; choosing one favorable repetition is forbidden

SimpleTM.repeat_rule: three native repetitions per H720 dataset cell

iTransformer.h720_profile_rule: use the pred_len=720 command from each released multivariate_forecasting script unchanged

PatchTST.solar_profile_rule: derive optimization profile from released ECL H720 command and use the official iTransformer-style Solar loader semantics; label source_informed_not_official

DLinear.solar_profile_rule: derive optimization profile from released ECL H720 command and use the official iTransformer-style Solar loader semantics; label source_informed_not_official

seed_and_repeat_policy.optional_three_seed_extension: only after the complete primary matrix and only if time allows; execute whole preregistered blocks without result-selective extension

prelaunch_gates: freeze exact source commit and source hashes for all three new repositories
implement and unit-test prediction/target export plus exact prefix metrics without accessing test during training
freeze PatchTST and DLinear Solar source-informed patches and their non-official labels
dry-run exactly 21 new H720 training jobs and 70 checkpoint prefix evaluations
run seven no-test resource smokes per newly trained baseline before the formal queue
check GPU occupancy and retain storage safety margin under the 220 GiB remote hard limit
commit and push the exact experiment code before remote execution

formal_result_gates.new_training: 21_of_21 checkpoints, configs, logs, unique hashes, numeric health, and zero training-time test access
formal_result_gates.prefix_test: 70_of_70 checkpoint evaluations and 280_of_280 raw horizon rows, comprising 7 immutable completed ISCF audits plus 63 newly executed checkpoint evaluations
formal_result_gates.aggregate_table: 224_of_224 system-dataset-horizon cells with both MSE and MAE
formal_result_gates.continuity: all exact local H720 anchors pass and all published-reference deviations are disclosed
formal_result_gates.negative_results: retain every preregistered dataset, horizon, metric, and repetition

rollback.source_or_script_mismatch: return to source audit; do not launch the affected baseline
rollback.solar_patch_failure: mark only the affected Solar cell block unresolved and block the entire Main II table from paper use
rollback.h720_exact_anchor_failure: stop publication, audit checkpoint, loader, preprocessing, metric, and repetition aggregation; do not overwrite Main I
rollback.numeric_or_artifact_failure: rerun the complete affected baseline block from its frozen checkpoint or training contract
rollback.performance_negative: report the complete matrix; do not delete the baseline or retune by horizon, metric, cell, or seed
rollback.protocol_heterogeneity: retain source-native system wording and do not promote to matched mechanism attribution
